TDA Toolkit Studio

Upload a numeric CSV, point to a local file path, or fetch a remote dataset URL. Then compute persistence, Mapper, and merge-tree views in one place.

Best current fit:

  • point_cloud for Mapper plus persistence
  • point_cloud or scalar_field for merge trees
  • graph for edge-list persistence

Sample CSV: examples/data.csv
